scripts.dev: concurrently -n "API,WEB,ML" -c "blue,green,yellow" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web" "npm run dev -w apps/ml-service"
scripts.dev:node: concurrently -n "API,WEB" -c "blue,green" "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
